education.degree: Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science

courses.name: Hardware Design
courses.description: Lab- and project-based course on designing hardware accelerators with software, using Verilog and high-level synthesis. Topics include pipelining, customized memory, AI/ML acceleration, and FPGA implementation.

courses.name: HCI & HAI
courses.description: Combines classic HCI—usability, design heuristics, and user studies—with human-centered AI: prompt engineering, AI interface design, agentic workflows, and evaluating AI-powered systems.

courses.name: Cloud Computing
courses.description: Fundamentals of cloud computing covering IaaS platforms, OpenStack, Big Data platforms, and data-center-scale systems. Includes influential papers and a mentored group project.

courses.name: Computational Biology
courses.description: Fundamental algorithms of modern bioinformatics and their applications to data, including genome assembly, sequence alignment, phylogenetic trees, gene regulation, and large-scale genomics.

courses.name: Machine Learning Practicum
courses.description: Spark! practicum applying algorithms, inferential analytics, and software development to real-world partner projects, with a machine-learning or analytics deliverable and final presentation.

courses.name: Applied Machine Learning
courses.description: Practical machine learning: clustering, classification, regression, feature selection, and model compression, with hands-on programming on real-world datasets.

courses.name: Mobile App Development
courses.description: Hands-on Android development with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and the Android SDK. Students build small apps, then collaborate on a substantial team project using agile practices.

courses.name: Software Engineering Practicum
courses.description: Spark! practicum applying programming and system development skills to real-world projects from partner organizations, with emphasis on teamwork, communication, and software process.

courses.name: Foundations of Data Science
courses.description: Foundation for data-intensive courses such as data science, machine learning, and data mining, covering theoretical fundamentals and practical working knowledge.

courses.name: Data Science Tools
courses.description: Practical skills for working with data, including clustering, classification, regression, and network analysis, with hands-on application via programming.

courses.name: Distributed Systems
courses.description: Programming-centric introduction to computer systems: design principles, performance, concurrency, transactions, consistency, parallelism, replication, fault tolerance, and distributed consensus.

courses.name: Database Systems
courses.description: Introduction to database management systems: data models, SQL, indexing and hashing, query optimization, transactions, concurrency control, recovery, integrity, and security.

courses.name: Algorithms
courses.description: Algorithm design and analysis: asymptotics, graph algorithms, greedy methods, dynamic programming, network flows, polynomial-time reductions, and NP-complete problems.

courses.name: Software Engineering
courses.description: Construction of reliable software, including testing methodologies, structured design, software quality, complexity, fault tolerance, and related engineering practices.

courses.name: Web App Development
courses.description: Hands-on web application development with HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, and MongoDB, covering Git workflows, UI construction, and full-stack deployment.

courses.name: Functional Programming
courses.description: Concepts in programming-language design: bindings, argument transmission, control structures, compile-time, load-time, and run-time environments, and interpreters.

courses.name: Probability
courses.description: Probabilistic concepts and methods used in computer science, emphasizing the role of randomness in computing and rigorous reasoning, analysis, and algorithmic thinking.

courses.name: Computer Systems
courses.description: Fundamentals of computer systems and systems programming: digital logic, processors, memory, I/O, instruction-set architecture, assembly, operating systems, and C.

courses.name: Linear Algebra
courses.description: Data structures and algorithms for geometric objects, including Cartesian geometry, transformations, queries and sampling, and triangulations, with emphasis on rigorous analysis.

courses.name: Discrete Mathematics
courses.description: Fundamentals of logic, proofs, counting, set theory, relations and functions, and combinatoric structures.

courses.name: Data Structures & OOP
courses.description: Advanced programming techniques and data structures, including recursion, algorithm analysis, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, searching, and sorting.
